verses.he: לְאָדָ֥ם מַֽעַרְכֵי־לֵ֑ב וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה מַעֲנֵ֥ה לָשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.en: The preparations of the heart are man’s, But the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.

verses.he: כָּֽל־דַּרְכֵי־אִ֭ישׁ זַ֣ךְ בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְתֹכֵ֖ן רוּח֣וֹת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; But the LORD weigheth the spirits.

verses.he: גֹּ֣ל אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וְ֝יִכֹּ֗נוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Commit thy works unto the LORD, And thy thoughts shall be established.

verses.he: כֹּ֤ל פָּעַ֣ל יְ֭הוָה לַֽמַּעֲנֵ֑הוּ וְגַם־רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לְי֣וֹם רָעָֽה׃
verses.en: The LORD hath made every things for His own purpose, Yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.

verses.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה כָּל־גְּבַהּ־לֵ֑ב יָ֥ד לְ֝יָ֗ד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃
verses.en: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; My hand upon it! he shall not be unpunished.

verses.he: בְּחֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭אֱמֶת יְכֻפַּ֣ר עָו‍ֹ֑ן וּבְיִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה ס֣וּר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.en: By mercy and truth iniquity is expiated; And by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.

verses.he: בִּרְצ֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה דַּרְכֵי־אִ֑ישׁ גַּם־א֝וֹיְבָ֗יו יַשְׁלִ֥ם אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: When a man’s ways please the LORD, He maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.

verses.he: טוֹב־מְ֭עַט בִּצְדָקָ֑ה מֵרֹ֥ב תְּ֝בוּא֗וֹת בְּלֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.en: Better is a little with righteousness Than great revenues with injustice.

verses.he: לֵ֣ב אָ֭דָם יְחַשֵּׁ֣ב דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה יָכִ֥ין צַעֲדֽוֹ׃
verses.en: A man’s heart deviseth his way; But the LORD directeth his steps.

verses.he: קֶ֤סֶם׀ עַֽל־שִׂפְתֵי־מֶ֑לֶךְ בְּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט לֹ֣א יִמְעַל־פִּֽיו׃
verses.en: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king; His mouth trespasseth not in judgment.

verses.he: פֶּ֤לֶס׀ וּמֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭שְׁפָּט לַֽיהוָ֑ה מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ כָּל־אַבְנֵי־כִֽיס׃
verses.en: A just balance and scales are the LORD’S; All the weights of the bag are His work.

verses.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת מְ֭לָכִים עֲשׂ֣וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע כִּ֥י בִ֝צְדָקָ֗ה יִכּ֥וֹן כִּסֵּֽא׃
verses.en: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness; For the throne is established by righteousness.

verses.he: רְצ֣וֹן מְ֭לָכִים שִׂפְתֵי־צֶ֑דֶק וְדֹבֵ֖ר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יֶאֱהָֽב׃
verses.en: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; And they love him that speaketh right.

verses.he: חֲמַת־מֶ֥לֶךְ מַלְאֲכֵי־מָ֑וֶת וְאִ֖ישׁ חָכָ֣ם יְכַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death; But a wise man will pacify it.

verses.he: בְּאוֹר־פְּנֵי־מֶ֥לֶךְ חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝רְצוֹנ֗וֹ כְּעָ֣ב מַלְקֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.en: In the light of the king’s countenance is life; And his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.

verses.he: קְֽנֹה־חָכְמָ֗ה מַה־טּ֥וֹב מֵחָר֑וּץ וּקְנ֥וֹת בִּ֝ינָ֗ה נִבְחָ֥ר מִכָּֽסֶף׃
verses.en: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! Yea, to get understanding is rather to be chosen than silver.

verses.he: מְסִלַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים ס֣וּר מֵרָ֑ע שֹׁמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ נֹצֵ֥ר דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil; He that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.

verses.he: לִפְנֵי־שֶׁ֥בֶר גָּא֑וֹן וְלִפְנֵ֥י כִ֝שָּׁל֗וֹן גֹּ֣בַהּ רֽוּחַ׃
verses.en: Pride goeth before destruction, And a haughty spirit before a fall.

verses.he: ט֣וֹב שְׁפַל־ר֭וּחַ אֶת־עניים [עֲנָוִ֑ים] מֵֽחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁ֝לָ֗ל אֶת־גֵּאִֽים׃
verses.en: Better it is to be of a lowly spirit with the humble, Than to divide the spoil with the proud.

verses.he: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל עַל־דָּ֭בָר יִמְצָא־ט֑וֹב וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּיהוָ֣ה אַשְׁרָֽיו׃
verses.en: He that giveth heed unto the word shall find good; And whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.

verses.he: לַחֲכַם־לֵ֭ב יִקָּרֵ֣א נָב֑וֹן וּמֶ֥תֶק שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח׃
verses.en: The wise in heart is called a man of discernment; And the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.

verses.he: מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים שֵׂ֣כֶל בְּעָלָ֑יו וּמוּסַ֖ר אֱוִלִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.en: Understanding is a fountain of life unto him that hath it; But folly is the chastisement of fools.

verses.he: לֵ֣ב חָ֭כָם יַשְׂכִּ֣יל פִּ֑יהוּ וְעַל־שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח׃
verses.en: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, And addeth learning to his lips.

verses.he: צוּף־דְּ֭בַשׁ אִמְרֵי־נֹ֑עַם מָת֥וֹק לַ֝נֶּפֶשׁ וּמַרְפֵּ֥א לָעָֽצֶם׃
verses.en: Pleasant words are as a honeycomb, Sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

verses.he: יֵ֤שׁ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יָ֭שָׁר לִפְנֵי־אִ֑ישׁ וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ דַּרְכֵי־מָֽוֶת׃
verses.en: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, But the end thereof are the ways of death.

verses.he: נֶ֣פֶשׁ עָ֭מֵל עָ֣מְלָה לּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־אָכַ֖ף עָלָ֣יו פִּֽיהוּ׃
verses.en: The hunger of the labouring man laboureth for him; For his mouth compelleth him.

verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ בְּ֭לִיַּעַל כֹּרֶ֣ה רָעָ֑ה וְעַל־שפתיו [שְׂ֝פָת֗וֹ] כְּאֵ֣שׁ צָרָֽבֶת׃
verses.en: An ungodly man diggeth up evil, And in his lips there is as a burning fire.

verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ תַּ֭הְפֻּכוֹת יְשַׁלַּ֣ח מָד֑וֹן וְ֝נִרְגָּ֗ן מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף׃
verses.en: A froward man soweth strife; And a whisperer separateth familiar friends.

verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ חָ֭מָס יְפַתֶּ֣ה רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝הוֹלִיכ֗וֹ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ לֹא־טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: A man of violence enticeth his neighbour, And leadeth him into a way that is not good.

verses.he: עֹצֶ֣ה עֵ֭ינָיו לַחְשֹׁ֣ב תַּהְפֻּכ֑וֹת קֹרֵ֥ץ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו כִּלָּ֥ה רָעָֽה׃
verses.en: He shutteth his eyes, it is to devise froward things; He that biteth his lips bringeth evil to pass.

verses.he: עֲטֶ֣רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת שֵׂיבָ֑ה בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה תִּמָּצֵֽא׃
verses.en: The hoary head is a crown of glory, It is found in the way of righteousness.

verses.he: ט֤וֹב אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם מִגִּבּ֑וֹר וּמֹשֵׁ֥ל בְּ֝רוּח֗וֹ מִלֹּכֵ֥ד עִֽיר׃
verses.en: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; And he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.

verses.he: בַּ֭חֵיק יוּטַ֣ל אֶת־הַגּוֹרָ֑ל וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה כָּל־מִשְׁפָּטֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The lot is cast into the lap; But the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.
